items.title: Deebo Samuel: Trending toward practicing Wednesday
items.text:
Samuel (hamstring) is on track to return to practice Wednesday, David Lombardi of SFStandard.com reports.

items.title: Mike Evans: Iffy for Wednesday's practice
items.text:

items.title: Gardner Minshew: Could face season-ending elbow surgery
items.text:
Per Adam Schefter of ESPN,  Minshew (elbow) is reportedly seeking additional medical opinions to confirm that he likely will require season-ending surgery to address a torn UCL.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jordan Davis: Sent to Jacksonville
items.text:
The Jaguars acquired Davis from the Eagles on Monday in exchange for a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joshua Palmer: Headed to injured reserve
items.text:
